name: native-cli
description: Scaffold a repo-owned Go resource binary with a first-class operator command surface and manifest-driven install/invoke metadata.

RESOURCE_PORTABILITY_TIER.description: Portability tier for the generated scaffold.

RESOURCE_CLI_COMMAND.description: Installed command name for the generated resource CLI.

platformExpectations: Generated scaffolds should treat the repo-owned Go binary as the primary operator surface.
Command wiring should stay separate from the resource domain implementation.
